---
name: Feature Request / Suggestion
about: Suggest a new feature, workflow enhancement, or UI improvement for Clara
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or workflow you would like to see.

### Motivation / Problem Statement
What problem does this solve or what workflow does this improve? (e.g., *"When working with 50+ plugins, finding..."*)

### Proposed Solution / Workflow
Describe how you envision it working from a user perspective:
- What does the UI look like?
- Are there new keyboard shortcuts, menu options, or settings?

### Alternatives Considered
Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

### Additional Context & Mockups
Add any screenshots, sketches, or reference links (e.g., from other DAWs like Bitwig, Reaper, or Blender) here.
